scripts.content: pnpm exec spago run -p site --main BuildContentMain
scripts.copy:assets: node scripts/fsx.mjs mkdir dist/assets dist/fonts && node scripts/fsx.mjs cp -r public/assets dist/assets && node scripts/fsx.mjs cp -r public/fonts dist/fonts && node scripts/fsx.mjs cp public/gfx-boot.js dist/gfx-boot.js
scripts.css: node scripts/fsx.mjs mkdir dist/css && cross-env BROWSERSLIST_IGNORE_OLD_DATA=1 pnpm exec tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i ./css/style.css -o ./dist/css/style.css --minify
scripts.prerender: pnpm exec spago run -p site --main PrerenderMain
scripts.bundle: pnpm run shaders && node scripts/fsx.mjs mkdir dist && pnpm exec spago bundle -p site --platform browser --bundle-type app --module Main --outfile dist/app.js && node scripts/fsx.mjs cp public/gfx-boot.js dist/gfx-boot.js
scripts.bundle:prod: pnpm run shaders && node scripts/fsx.mjs mkdir dist && pnpm exec purs-backend-es build --int-tags && pnpm exec purs-backend-es bundle-app -m Main -p browser --minify --no-build -t dist/app.js && node scripts/fsx.mjs cp public/gfx-boot.js dist/gfx-boot.js
scripts.bundle:with-css: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run css
scripts.bundle:prod:with-css: pnpm run bundle:prod && pnpm run css
scripts.spago:build: pnpm run shaders && pnpm exec spago build
scripts.build: pnpm run content && pnpm run spago:build && pnpm run bundle:prod && pnpm run prerender && pnpm run css && pnpm run copy:assets
